dataset.name: NKI HER2-negative neoadjuvant breast cancer RNA-seq cohort (GSE192341)
dataset.description: Independent HER2-negative breast cancer cohort with treatment-naive tumor-biopsy bulk RNA sequencing and individual recurrence-free-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The GEO release contains 87 fresh-frozen pretreatment breast tumor biopsies from patients scheduled for neoadjuvant chemotherapy at the Netherlands Cancer Institute. Seventy-two expression-linked patients have both an individual recurrence-free-survival time and recurrence status; the remaining 15 profiles are retained in the source release but excluded from survival analysis because the endpoint is incomplete.
dataset.publication_citation: Hoogstraat et al. npj Breast Cancer 2022

metadata.source_program: Netherlands Cancer Institute HER2-negative neoadjuvant breast cancer study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and npj Breast Cancer
metadata.library_method: Bulk RNA sequencing of fresh-frozen pretreatment biopsies with greater than 50% tumor, 50-bp single-end libraries, TopHat 2.1 alignment to the GRCh37 release 75 transcriptome and gene-level lcount quantification
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined recurrence-free survival after treatment-naive biopsy and neoadjuvant therapy
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The public release supplies RFS in years and recurrence status but does not state a precise calendar origin for the interval. TRACE Explorer preserves the source RFS label and does not reinterpret it as TCGA DFI or PFI.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Each GEO record represents one treatment-naive tumor biopsy. Exactly 72 of 87 records contain both positive RFS time and an explicit recurrence status; endpoint-incomplete records are excluded deterministically.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: Age, subtype, pathologic response, nodal status, recurrence and RFS are embedded in the GEO family SOFT and linked to count-matrix columns by the source sample_id.
metadata.expression_curation_note: TRACE Explorer computes library sizes across all 42,877 released Ensembl rows and applies log2(CPM + 1). The source-declared pinned GRCh37 release 75 annotation maps 41,460 rows; 1,417 identifiers absent from that reference and 78 symbols represented by multiple Ensembl genes are excluded, leaving 40,505 analyzable symbols.
metadata.overlap_note: The NKI neoadjuvant cohort is independent of TCGA-BRCA and of the active SCAN-B, CNP, BRCA-KR, POG570 and iAtlas breast cancer releases. GSE34138 contributes additional microarray profiles to the source publication but is not included in this RNA-seq release.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO count matrix in place. Direct source-file redistribution remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 75 GRCh37 gene_name annotation declared by the source
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols assigned to more than one Ensembl gene are excluded rather than silently combined.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer calculates CPM from all 42,877 released source rows before applying log2(CPM + 1). Values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-defined recurrence-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Source follow-up origin not explicitly reported
endpoints.event_definition: Breast cancer recurrence according to the GEO clinical record
